# Project Reference {.unnumbered}

Quick reference for all projects covered in this history.

| Project | Campus | Year | Era | Impact |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ARPANET Node 1 and RFCs | UCLA | 1969 | The Internet Itself | Node 1, first message, RFC process |
| ARPANET Node 3 | UC Santa Barbara | 1969 | The Internet Itself | Culler and Fried; 2 of the 4 original nodes were UC |
| BSD TCP/IP stack | UC Berkeley | 1983 | The Internet Itself | Implementation that spread TCP/IP universally |
| BSD Unix | UC Berkeley | 1970s-80s | Foundations | Licensing model for open source |
| INGRES / PostgreSQL | UC Berkeley | 1973 / 1986 | Foundations | Ancestors of PostgreSQL |
| tz database | UCLA (Paul Eggert) | 1986 | Universal Infrastructure | Time zone data in most operating systems |
| Apache HTTP Server | UCB (Behlendorf) | 1995 | Universal Infrastructure | Most-used web server for years; 50% of active sites (Dec 2015) |
| UCSC Genome Browser | UC Santa Cruz | 2000 | Open Science | Reference for genomic research worldwide |
| EEGLAB | UC San Diego (began at Salk) | 1997-2001 | Open Science | About 26,800 citations (Nov 2026) |
| Cytoscape | UC San Diego (with ISB, Whitehead) | 2003 | Open Science | 300K+ downloads a year (2025) |
| Jupyter | UC Berkeley (IPython began at CU Boulder) | 2001 / 2014 | Scientific Computing | Dominant interface for interactive computing |
| Apache Spark | UC Berkeley | 2009 | Scientific Computing | Large-scale data processing; Apache project |
| Ceph | UC Santa Cruz | 2004 | Infrastructure at Scale | Exabyte storage; funded CROSS/first UC OSPO |
| RISC-V | UC Berkeley | 2010 | Infrastructure at Scale | 305 member organizations (Nov 2026) |
| Named Data Networking | UCLA | 2010 | Infrastructure at Scale | Future internet architecture research |
| Ray | UC Berkeley | 2016 | Infrastructure at Scale | Distributed Python and AI compute; PyTorch Foundation (2025) |

: {tbl-colwidths="[18,15,8,20,39]"}
